$comment: Licence policy for everything that ships in Levuvo Mail (docs/compliance/LICENSING.md). allowed: no review needed. review: allowed only with an entry in exceptions (package name -> reason). Anything else fails the check. Expressions with OR pass if one alternative is allowed; AND needs all.

exceptions.openpgp: LGPL-3.0+: used unmodified as a separate module in node_modules (not bundled into the UI), its source is public on npm/GitHub and the licence text ships in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt. Confirm with a lawyer how the asar integrity fuse relates to LGPL-3.0 section 4 (docs/compliance/OPEN-ITEMS.md L8).
exceptions.tabrion: Own package of Levuvo's author (peterkarlhuber/tabrion), no licence metadata.
exceptions.orkexa: Own package of Levuvo's author (peterkarlhuber/orkexa), no licence metadata.
